name: Boombox Mini
summary: A small Bluetooth speaker. £89. Fabric front, five buttons, and a battery The Fix Club can replace.
concept: A portable Bluetooth speaker with a fabric front, a soft-touch body and buttons you can find without looking. Small and light.
why_it_exists: Many portable speakers are too small to hear or too big to carry. This one fits a bag, a shelf or a picnic, plays clearly and has a battery that can be replaced.
target_customer: People who want music in a kitchen, garden or campsite without a fuss.

physical.form: A rounded rectangular body with a woven fabric front, a flat top with five raised buttons and a strap loop at each end. USB-C on the back.

features: It plays clear, loud sound that fills a room, and the battery runs for up to 14 hours at medium volume.
It connects to two phones at once, so a friend can take over the music without any fuss.
You charge it with a USB-C cable, the same kind many phones already use.
The five buttons are different shapes and sit in the same place every time, so you can find them without looking.
It is small and light enough to carry in a bag, and it has a strap loop at each end.
arrives: The speaker sits in a card cradle inside a brown card sleeve, so it is held firmly without any foam. The cable is tied with a paper loop. The charger is not included, so use any USB-C charger you have.
specs: Soft-touch recycled plastic, woven polyester fabric front, rubberised base, aluminium strap loops
Off-white with orange and sky blue accents
12 W, one driver and two passive radiators. 70 Hz to 20 kHz. Built-in microphone for speakerphone calls.
Up to 14 hours at medium volume. Less at high volume (3,000 mAh, not user-removable).
USB-C, up to 18 W, about 3 hours from flat. Works with the Blip Charger or any USB-C charger.
Bluetooth 5.3, about 10 m in the open, SBC and AAC
how_it_works: Hold the power button for two seconds. Hold the pair button until the light blinks, then choose Boombox Mini on your phone. Charge it over USB-C.
in_the_box: No plug. Use the Blip Charger or any USB-C charger.

accessories.name: Travel Case
accessories.tagline: A padded case that fits the speaker.
accessories.description: A padded zip case made for the Boombox Mini, with a small pocket for the cable. The speaker fits snugly inside. It does not fit other speakers or Blip.
specs: 18 x 8.5 x 8.5 cm, for a speaker that is 16.8 x 7.4 x 7.4 cm
Woven polyester outer, foam padding, nylon zip
Off-white with a blue zip, orange zip pull and yellow carry loop
Wipe with a damp cloth. Air dry.

compatibility.note: Pairs over Bluetooth. They share a charger.
Blip accessories fit Blip only, except the charger.

packaging: A kraft card sleeve with a card cradle that holds the speaker without foam. The cable is held with a paper loop.

warranty.summary: It has a 24-month warranty against faults in how it was made. Battery fade to 80% is wear, and drops and liquid damage are not covered. See Warranty.

care: Wipe the body and grille with a dry or slightly damp cloth.
Keep the USB-C port dry. Let the speaker dry fully after a splash before charging.
Do not leave it in a hot car or in direct sun for hours.
Charge it every few months if it is in storage.
safety: It resists splashes. Do not put it under water.
Loud sound can harm your hearing.
If the battery swells or gets hot, stop using it, unplug it and contact us.

delivery.note: Soon or Sooner. Soon is free over £50.

returnable.note: You can return it within 30 days. You may switch it on and try it, but it must be undamaged, complete, in its box and reset. See Returns.

sections.title: Size and battery
sections.body: It is 168 mm long and plays for up to 14 hours.

sections.title: Buttons
sections.body: Five raised buttons on top: power, play, volume up, volume down and pair.

sections.title: Charging
sections.body: It charges over USB-C with the Blip Charger or any USB-C charger. A short cable is in the box.

faq.q: Does it have an aux socket?
Can I pair two speakers for stereo?
faq.a: No. Two Boombox Minis play separately.
The Blip Charger or any USB-C charger. The cable is in the box.

faq.q: How long does the battery last?
faq.a: Up to 14 hours at medium volume. Less when it is loud.
No. It resists splashes. Do not put it under water or charge it wet.
Yes. The Fix Club does it for £35.

steps: Switch the speaker off and on.
Hold the pair button until the light blinks.
Delete Boombox Mini from your phone's Bluetooth list and pair again.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Try a second phone. If that fails too, open a support case.

steps: Push the cable in fully and check the port for lint.
troubleshooting.if_unresolved: Open a support case. In warranty, The Fix Club will look at it.

steps: Lower the volume on the speaker and the phone.
Move closer. Bluetooth reaches about 10 m in the open.

photography_direction: Solid and calm. Woven grille and matte body are the point. One speaker, with a mug or plant for scale. No glowing rings, no light-up gimmicks.
